name: io.github.valeriikot/zread
description: Standalone GitHub docs & code reader (MCP server). Reads repository docs and source straight from GitHub — no account, no external service.

environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token for higher API rate limits and private repos
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Preferred docs language, zh or en
environmentVariables.name: ZREAD_LANG
